name: NEXTDC GE1 Geelong Data Centre
notes: NEXTDC describes GE1 as an in-development 4.4MW facility in Corio; DCD and local reporting say construction has begun after fast state planning approval.

name: NEXTDC Lovely Banks landholding data centre concept
notes: Property reporting says NEXTDC bought 169ha at Lovely Banks near major power infrastructure with an intent to develop a large-scale data centre; no public capacity or permit details found.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Shepparton regional facility
notes: LEDC's Victorian regional rollout materials and trade coverage named Shepparton as a future regional data centre location, but I found no later site-specific construction or opening evidence.

name: CDC Brooklyn Campus
notes: CDC says its Brooklyn campus has operated since 2024 and is expected to provide more than 350MW at completion; official 2026 opening coverage says the campus has two data centre facilities.

name: CDC Laverton Campus
notes: CDC lists Laverton as under construction and says it will add more than 400MW on completion; Victorian Government material confirms CDC is developing a second campus in Laverton North.

name: GreenSquareDC MEL1 Spotswood
notes: GreenSquareDC says it is proposing a data centre at 44-76 Simcock Avenue, Spotswood, designed for up to 240MW IT capacity; local reporting says a planning application has been filed.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Horsham regional facility
notes: LEDC's regional Victoria rollout materials and trade coverage named Horsham as a planned data centre location; no later public evidence of delivery found.

name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne Tullamarine
notes: NEXTDC lists M2 in Tullamarine as an operational 120MW+ Tier IV certified data centre; contractor material also notes ongoing expansion works at the facility.

name: AirTrunk MEL2 Melbourne Tullamarine
notes: AirTrunk says MEL2 in Melbourne's north-west is a multi-building hyperscale campus with 354MW+ total capacity; the company announced the A$5bn expansion in early 2026.

name: Vantage MEL1 Melbourne Tullamarine campus
notes: Vantage lists its Melbourne campus in Tullamarine, six kilometres from Melbourne Airport, with 64MW of IT capacity across a 7-acre campus.

name: AWS Craigieburn data centre
notes: ABC reported that Amazon sought and received ministerial approval for a new A$250m data centre in Craigieburn; Amazon's broader official material confirms large Australian data centre expansion but does not disclose the site capacity.

name: AirTrunk Mickleham / Fusion Business Park campus
notes: Trade and property reports say an AirTrunk-linked application was filed for a data centre at 45 Donnybrook Road, Mickleham, on a 67ha site with up to seven buildings.

name: Zerra DC Campbellfield / former Ford factory campus
notes: ABC local coverage reports a major Campbellfield data centre proposal with large diesel storage concerns; Baxtel and local petition material identify the developer as Zerra DC and describe a six-building campus around 300-340 Barry Road.

name: Project Nexus Sunbury hyperscale data centre concept
notes: Local reporting says HiQ's proposed Project Nexus at Sunbury includes a 1GW hyperscale data centre, 1GW battery and waste-to-energy precinct; the broader concept is exploratory and faces local opposition.

name: Goodman Clayton Business Park data centre redevelopment
notes: Planning Victoria records a Development Facilitation Program application for 1508 Centre Road, Clayton South; later reporting says the former Volkswagen/Nissan/Volvo factory on the broader Clayton Business Park site was demolished for a state-of-the-art data centre. Public capacity not found.

name: NAB Knox data centre
notes: DCD reported NAB's Knox data centre at 122 Lewis Road remains a data centre but is slated for closure as NAB migrates to cloud; older iTnews coverage confirms NAB retained a Knox, Victoria data centre during earlier consolidation.
